definition: For a small set of assistance programs whose eligible recipients are fixed by statute or program rule, an award record that the agency coded with recipient type X (Other) is assigned the program's recipient class. The rule never overrides a reported recipient type, never reads recipient names or addresses, and applies only to records that would otherwise be unclassified. Every affected program is listed here with the eligibility basis; audit counts are in data/recipient-sector-audit.json.
applies_to: Records with sector 'Unknown / unclassified' after explicit FABS codes and same-UEI evidence; program code must match exactly.
